currentWork.title: FINAL.34 rotated fullscreen MAP gesture and arrival-card orientation fix
currentWork.releaseStatus: Implementation is validated on PR #166 and awaits production merge/live verification. FINAL.33 remains the current production release until merge.
fieldEvidence: In software-rotated fullscreen MAP, drag input followed the unrotated portrait coordinate system, making the map move in a different direction from the visible gesture.
Arrival visit cards remained portrait-oriented while the fullscreen MAP was software-rotated.
scope: While fullscreen MAP software rotation is active, disable native Leaflet dragging and remap pointer deltas by 90 degrees before panning the map.
Do not alter normal portrait MAP dragging.
While fullscreen MAP software rotation is active, rotate only the arrival visit sheet to the same visual orientation.
While that rotated arrival sheet is active, interpret the sheet's visible left/right swipe along the rotated pointer axis.
Preserve existing task/order confirmation flow, visit skip semantics, fullscreen PIN interaction, and non-rotated arrival behavior.
